concerns.text: The primary outcome `review_effort_duration` is defined for LLM‑generated code but the specification provides no mechanism to obtain real timestamps for synthetic PRs. The design therefore relies on a synthetic review‑time simulation (e.g., sampling from a KDE conditioned on the same covariates used for propensity‑score matching). This makes the validation target a deterministic function of the predictors, creating a circular/tautological validation that cannot answer the research question “do LLM‑generated code require longer review effort?”
